The Loki TV show sets up the foundational lore for the Multiverse Saga. Disney The Doctor Strange movies show how realities break down in the Marvel universe. Disney+ The Marvel Cinematic Universe sure is a lot of sci-fi to consume and even if you are the biggest Marvel fan, you might not be up to date on all of the shows and movies. With Avengers: Doomsday releasing on Dec. 18 , now is a good time to do some studying if you want to a working understanding of the lore and storyline.

If you are a total beginner to this whole multiverse thing, start with the TV show Loki and the movie Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness . It breaks down the rules for the multiverse, exploring concepts like timeline branching, superhero councils and incursions.

The Fantastic Four reboot and the newly released VisionQuest introduce the titular villain of the upcoming movie release, Dr. Doom. As with all Marvel content, make sure to pay attention to post-credits scenes for key character reveals! You can also check out the original Fantastic Four movies from the noughties, where Chris Evans plays the Human Torch. Wait, I thought he was Captain America?

Still confused? For a lore breakdown of the multiverse, watch Loki, Doctor Strange and The Fantastic Four reboot.
